description: This file defines the ExceptionMiddleware class for handling exceptions in ASP.NET Core web applications. It intercepts exceptions during HTTP request processing, sets appropriate HTTP status codes, and returns error details in JSON format.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for intercepting and handling exceptions during HTTP request processing in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main method invoked per HTTP request to catch exceptions and delegate to the exception handler.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting HTTP response status code and returning a JSON error message, with special handling for DuplicateException.
